articles.title: Probate no longer mandatory: what it means for estate planning
articles.summary: The omission of Section 213 of the Indian Succession Act, 1925 has changed the legal position on probate in India. While probate remains available, it is no longer a statutory precondition in cases that were earlier covered by Section 213.
